title: Caching Strategies
description: Deep dive into React Query caching mechanisms, cache configuration, and invalidation strategies.
longDescription: This module covers advanced caching strategies in React Query including cache time and stale time configuration, garbage collection lifecycle, background refetching behavior, cache invalidation patterns with queryClient, and how to tune cache settings for different application needs. You will learn how React Query's two-layer cache model works under the hood, when data is considered stale, how unused queries are removed from memory, and how to keep your server state in sync after mutations.
whatYouLearn: Configure cacheTime and staleTime at both global and per-query levels
Understand how garbage collection removes unused queries from memory
Use queryClient.invalidateQueries, setQueryData, and removeQueries to keep cache in sync
Control background refetching triggers: window focus, reconnect, mount, and interval
Persist cache across sessions using localStorage and IndexedDB persistence plugins
